answer: Before an agent may earn, it escrows 40 POA for a 12-epoch voyage and passes three randomly assigned peer audits. Each additional identity must lock another 40 POA; if two accounts reuse a signed work trace, both stakes burn, while auditors publish receipts anyone can verify. A sable reputation badge appears only after all three rounds, and rewards rise slowly from an ember-sized cap, so a Sybil farm pays linearly upfront but earns sublinearly before detection.
